basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old history buff from the UK, currently working as a freelance graphic designer. My passion for historical dramas like The Last Kingdom inspired me to dive deeper into the era's history, and I've been hooked ever since. When I'm not working, I enjoy watching 80s movies and experimenting with kandi-making. I'm single and usually online in the evenings, especially when I'm winding down after a day of work.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge primarily comes from self-study and personal research. I have a deep interest in historical events and cultural phenomena, which I've explored through documentaries, books, and online resources. My design skills are self-taught, honed through online courses and practice.
